messages:
tara_sales: Heads-up  Aurion (payments infra) wants a POC. They provided two variants: aurion-lite-int8 and aurion-pro-qat. Requirements: Dedicated with Hosted fallback, steady 45-60 qps depending on peak, p95 <200ms for lite and <700ms for pro. Also they asked about committed pricing, BYO-KMS, and SOC2 evidence. CC @ben_eng @sophia_ml @raj_ops.

ben_eng: Got it. Need max sequence length, tokenizer, and whether there are custom CUDA ops or fused kernels. Also request a minimal loader script and a tiny synthetic checkpoint for quick validation.

tara_sales: Seq max = 3072, tokenizer = HF BPE with a 2.5k custom vocab. They called out "QAT fused attention" in the model notes but claim no external custom CUDA libs. They also need reproducibility for compliance flows.

sophia_ml: 3k seq + KV cache is memory sensitive. QAT fused attention may not match our kernel paths; ask for an unfused checkpoint or plain PyTorch forward path. Request a small labeled eval set (100-200 examples) to verify determinism and regression.

raj_ops: Infra notes: for 50 qps batched we should plan 2 reserved optimized nodes for lite, possibly 3-4 for pro if multi-card. BYO-KMS supported for Dedicated/Private; Hosted requires enterprise onboarding and an ops ticket for key integration. I can run a cost sim after we confirm batch sizes and sequence mix.

tara_sales: They want a quick ballpark to include in the procurement doc before detailed sim.

raj_ops: Ballpark: lite ~ "$13k/mo" (1-2 reserved), pro ~ "$39k/mo" (multi-card). These are placeholders pending perf profile.

sophia_ml: On the onboarding plan: 1) compatibility scan (load + forward) 2) perf profile (batch and KV cache configs) 3) quant sweep + tuning 4) canary on Dedicated then enable Hosted fallback. Owners: @ben_eng scan/profile, @sophia_ml quant, @raj_ops infra, @anita_sec SQ.

ben_eng: For the compatibility scan I need: s3 link with tokenizer files, loader script, and either weights or a small checkpoint (~100MB). Also expected input shapes and any special attention mask behavior.

anita_sec: I'll draft SQ responses. Key points: default retention = ephemeral unless configured, KV cache ephemeral and not persisted by default, audit logs exportable to customer SIEM, BYO-KMS supported on Dedicated/Private, Hosted requires enterprise onboarding (2-3 weeks). Will include SOC2 pointer and pen-test summary.

tara_sales: Proposed timeline to Aurion: send artifacts today, compatibility scan Tue-Wed, perf/quant Thu, canary Dedicated Fri if scans pass. KMS onboarding 2-3 weeks for prod. Is that acceptable?

ben_eng: Ack. I'll schedule the scan and block time Tue-Wed. If fused ops show up, we'll request an unfused path or implement a short adapter but prefer unfused to keep the timetable.

sophia_ml: I'll prep quant profiles and a deterministic eval harness. Ask Aurion to include expected outputs for the labeled set to validate determinism.

raj_ops: I'll prep the cost sim and KMS ticket template. Note: maintenance window Wed 02:00-03:00 UTC could impact fallback testing.

opsbot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance Wed 02:00-03:00 UTC  Hosted may be briefly unavailable.

tara_sales: Thanks all  I'll post S3 links and the SQ answers when I have them. :thumbsup:
